name: Venlafaxine
metabolism: Hepatic CYP2D6 O-demethylation produces active O-desmethylvenlafaxine (desvenlafaxine). Other demethylation/conjugation routes also occur. Elimination is mainly urinary as parent and metabolites.
summary: Venlafaxine is an oral serotonin–norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor used to treat major depressive disorder and several anxiety disorders.
toxicities: DailyMed label warnings include potentially life-threatening serotonin syndrome, elevated blood pressure (including sustained hypertension), increased bleeding risk, hyponatremia, seizures, and suicidal thoughts or behaviors, with increased risk in adolescents and young adults.

Abrupt discontinuation or dose reduction can produce dizziness, sensory disturbances, agitation, anxiety, insomnia, nausea, vomiting, sweating, and other symptoms; serious and protracted cases have been reported.
Other label warnings include mania/hypomania activation and angle-closure glaucoma in susceptible people.
generalRisks: The label is for prescription extended-release capsules. About suicidality (especially through age 24), potentially life-threatening serotonin syndrome, elevated blood pressure, bleeding, hyponatremia, seizures, mania/hypomania, angle-closure glaucoma, and significant discontinuation symptoms. MAOI use is contraindicated; co-use with other serotonergic medicines can increase serotonin-syndrome risk.
saferUse: Monitor for worsening mood or suicidal thoughts, especially early in treatment and after dose changes; seek urgent care for severe agitation with fever, sweating, tremor, rigidity, confusion, or seizure.
Check blood pressure during prescribed treatment and seek medical advice for a sustained increase.
Do not stop abruptly; the label recommends gradual reduction with clinical supervision. Check before combining with serotonergic drugs, NSAIDs, aspirin, warfarin, or other anticoagulants.
dosageRemark: The label is for prescription extended-release capsules. Prescription dosing is not recreational dose guidance; recreational thresholds and durations are not established here.
